about: Read by job-weekly's update_check.py to tell people a newer version exists. Information only: nothing here is run.

versions.summary: Three touches per person (a comment on their post about the job, the message, one nudge), chat prep with a closing ask, LinkedIn searches you run, and Lios.
helps: a short, specific comment on the post where someone advertised the job you applied for, posted by you, as the first of three touches
informational chats prepared from the person's path and the company's news, with 4-5 questions and a closing ask (including feedback on your core interview answers)
links for your alumni tab, the company's People tab and people searches, with the filters to click
Lios for graduate schemes, internships and spring weeks

versions.summary: One click to apply or send, a route for every job (referral first or apply now), work emails for the people on each job, one Fit score, and a lighter setup.
helps: Claude submits an application or sends an email when you tap Approve for it: one click, nothing else
referral first only where someone who knows you is there (2 working days at most); otherwise apply today and reach the hiring manager, the recruiter and the team the same day
work emails from RocketReach, Apollo or Hunter (through Orthogonal) if you connect one; phone numbers only if you turn them on
one Fit score per job, so more good jobs reach you
after-applying notes to recruiters, names from LinkedIn posts that advertised the role and from Handshake

versions.summary: A quick job audit, a 10-second CV skim, cover letters that face the biggest gap, and a 10-minute try-it message.
helps: say 'How well do I match this job?' for a match score, the top 5 missing keywords, the 3 red flags and what a strong applicant would show
every CV gets a 10-second skim: red flags strongest first and a yes, maybe or no pile
cover letters name your biggest gap plainly with what's true instead, never an apology
friends can try it in 10 minutes on any Claude plan before setting anything up

versions.summary: Graduate job sites: Milkround, Graduate Recruitment Bureau and Higherin (formerly RateMyPlacement).
helps: more graduate and entry-level jobs in the UK through their email alerts

versions.summary: Add-ons: a portfolio website from your evidence, a career-switch plan, and batch apply sessions.
helps: a one-page portfolio site of real results, checked for truth and privacy, published where you choose
a career-switch plan: what transfers, bridge roles, the quickest credible proof for each gap, and your switch story
apply to your whole apply list in one sitting: Claude fills each form, you press Submit and say next

versions.summary: Who to contact, best for the role first: the hiring manager and the team are searched for every new job, and ranked ahead of connections in other departments.
helps: every new job is searched for its hiring manager and team, not only jobs where you know nobody
who to contact is ranked by fit for the role first; people you know break ties
each person comes with the first step: message, connection request with a note, or an email

versions.summary: Referrals for every job: people you know are matched at once, the hiring manager's title is read from the ad, and an optional search on your computer finds people on the team.
helps: every job shows who you already know at that company, ranked for a referral, packs or not
the hiring manager's title is read from the ad
an optional task on your computer finds the hiring manager and people on the team through Google

versions.summary: Fixes from the first scheduled run: full job ads instead of summaries, no silent skips, an apply list prepared in advance, and a threshold check.
helps: job ads are read in full, one at a time, so big feeds aren't cut off
every watched company is checked, or the alert says why not
say 'apply to these' from anywhere: packs, form answers and referral drafts are ready for your next session
if no job reaches your alert thresholds after 10+ scored, the weekly check suggests a recalibration
an employer's request that AI not apply is quoted to you; filling the form is your call, and you press Submit

versions.summary: Interview debriefs and proof packs, overclaiming checks on CVs, negotiation lines and rehearsal, applications by email, Job Seek as a job source, and automatic updates.
helps: a debrief after each real interview and a question bank that shapes the next round
a one-page proof pack before each interview, checked against your evidence
CVs can't quietly upgrade 'contributed to' into 'led', or call work published when it's under review
set your ask, accept and walk-away lines before negotiating, and rehearse the call
applications by email when a posting says 'send your CV to'
jobs from thousands more company career pages through Job Seek
updates that arrive and apply themselves, asking only when you're needed

versions.summary: Referral path, Google people search, contact checks before any draft.
helps: find people on a team through Google without going on LinkedIn
a referral path: hello, thank-you, the ask, one nudge, stop
warnings before writing to someone unverified or to a recruiter who just rejected you
